implemented: Option premium buys/sells post signed cash and P&L entries to a durable double-entry journal.

Short naked positions reserve owner-supplied margin per lot; same-underlying, same-kind, same-expiry protective verticals reserve strike-width exposure. Rejected margin-expanding trades do not append.
Expiry handles cash-settled intrinsic value and physically exercised/assigned calls and puts, with cash obligations, underlying positions, settlement marks, and trial balance reconciled.
Multi-leg physical call-spread expiry test reconciles both legs, margin reserve, cash and realized result; cash-settled put and physical short-put assignment scenarios also pass.
Contract and settlement source hashes are retained; event IDs are idempotent; restart reproduces cash, positions, P&L and ledger balance.
scope_note: Satisfies PE-0095's paper expiry acceptance tests. Margin values are sourced caller inputs and spread width reserves are conservative paper estimates, not verified exchange/broker margin. The module is not connected to live market capture, the common forward runner, external option contract masters, taxes/fees, intraday option marking, or a claim of profitability; those are separate integration and evidence tasks. Open option positions with no option mark report equity/P&L as unavailable.
